farmersdelight.config.enableVanillaCropC: Farmer's Delight adds crates (3x3) for vanilla crops, similar to Quark and Thermal Cultivation. Should they be craftable?
Should Novice and Apprentice Farmers buy this mod's crops? (May reduce chances of other trades appearing)
farmersdelight.config.wanderingTraderSel: Should the Wandering Trader sell some of this mod's items? (Currently includes crop seeds and onions)
farmersdelight.config.richSoilBoostChanc: How often (in percentage) should Rich Soil succeed in boosting a plant's growth at each random tick? Set it to 0.0 to disable this.
farmersdelight.config.cuttingBoardFortun: How much of a bonus (in percentage) should each level of Fortune grant to Cutting Board chances? Set it to 0.0 to disable this.
farmersdelight.config.comfortFoodTagEffe: Should items inside the tag 'farmersdelight:comfort_foods' grant 2 minutes of Comfort when eaten? (defaults to vanilla SoupItems)
farmersdelight.config.rabbitStewJumpBoos: Should Rabbit Stew grant users the jumping prowess of a rabbit when eaten?
farmersdelight.config.dispenserUsesTools: Dispenser uses tools on cutting board
Should most vanilla tools register a dispenser behavior when facing a Cutting Board?
farmersdelight.config.enableStackableSou: Should SoupItems in the following list become stackable to 16, much like Farmer's Delight's meals?
farmersdelight.config.soupItemList.toolt: List of SoupItems. Default: vanilla soups and stews.
farmersdelight.config.overrideAllSoupIte: Toggle this setting to instead make ALL SoupItems stackable, except the ones on the list (deny-list). This affects items from other mods, so be careful!
farmersdelight.config.generateFDChestLoo: Should this mod add some of its items (ropes, seeds, knives, meals etc.) as extra chest loot across Minecraft?
farmersdelight.config.genVillageCompostH: Generate Compost Heaps across all village biomes
farmersdelight.config.chance.tooltip: Chance of generating clusters. Smaller value = more frequent.
farmersdelight.config.genWildPotatoes.to: Generate wild potatoes on cold biomes (temperature between 0.0 and 0.3)
farmersdelight.config.genWildCarrots.too: Generate wild carrots on temperate biomes (temperature between 0.4 and 0.9)
farmersdelight.config.genWildOnions.tool: Generate wild onions on temperate biomes (temperature between 0.4 and 0.9)
farmersdelight.config.genWildTomatoes.to: Generate tomato vines on arid biomes (temperature 1.0 or higher)
farmersdelight.config.genWildRice.toolti: Generate wild rice on swamps and jungles
farmersdelight.config.nourishmentHungerO: Should the hunger bar have a gilded overlay when the player has the Nourishment effect?
farmersdelight.config.comfortHealthOverl: Should the health bar have a silver sheen when the player has the Comfort effect?
Should food tooltips display which effects they provide?
farmersdelight.config.canvasSignDarkBack: Dye color IDs whose canvas signs should use white text by default.
